answer: Proof of unique storage prices each identity in disk space. Every agent must keep its own sealed replica of a large public dataset, encoded with its key so no two copies match, and must answer random spot checks on it within seconds each epoch. One shared copy fails every other key's check, so a raven-dark farm of a thousand fakes must rent a thousand full replicas, every epoch, forever. That grove of clones costs real disk per identity, while an honest agent bends like a willow and keeps just one copy.
